# Mantisy

> Mantisy is a digital studio in Russey Keo, Phnom Penh, Cambodia. We design brands, build custom apps, systems and AI, and offer ready-made products that we tailor to each client. Founded 2018.

## Services

- [Design & Brand](https://mantisy.com/services/ux): Brand identity and product design from one team, tested with real users in Khmer and English.
- [App & System Development](https://mantisy.com/services/mobile): Custom mobile apps, websites and internal systems, built in two-week sprints with source code handed over.
- [AI Development](https://mantisy.com/services/ai): Custom AI models trained on the client's own data to solve a specific business problem.

## Products

- [DWM](https://mantisy.com/products/dwm): Document and workflow management. Filing, approvals and sign-off in one place, with a full audit trail. Khmer and English.
- [JotPark](https://mantisy.com/products/jotpark): Digital parking tickets for staffed car and motorbike parks. Photo check at entry and exit, and shift takings that add up. No barriers needed.
- [Seek](https://mantisy.com/products/seek): AI visual product search. Shoppers search a retailer's catalogue by photo, text or barcode. Trained on each client's products and delivered as an API.
- [Super Store](https://mantisy.com/products/super-store): E-commerce and marketplace platform with web and mobile apps, KHQR payments, stock and delivery.
- [Cloud Stream](https://mantisy.com/products/cloud-stream): White-label streaming platform for music, video, podcasts and books, with subscriptions and content protection.

## Work

- [AEON Online](https://mantisy.com/work/aeon-online): Opening AEON's online shop into a marketplace, with customer, web, merchant and driver apps on one catalogue.
- [Go Digital Cambodia](https://godigital.gov.kh/): National digital literacy portal for the Ministry of Post and Telecommunications. UX/UI, web and CMS.
